description.value: A hotel located in McBride, a small village on the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16) between Prince George and Jasper in the Robson Valley. McBride is a common overnight stop for touring cyclists riding across northern BC, and this property is part of the Sandman Hotels chain. The hotel sits along the frontage road just off the highway.
